{{Quote|No use, your highness! He's stopped sending!|The Ensign|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 9">[[Star Wars (1977) 9|''Star Wars'' (1977) 9]]</ref>}}
A '''Rebel ensign''' served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as a [[Communications officer/Legends|communications officer]] in the secret base on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. When [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] cut off all communications between his [[Blockade runner|ship]] and the Rebel base, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] ordered the [[Ensign/Legends|ensign]] to boost the receiving power. The ensign replied that that would be useless because Skywalker had stopped sending and that they had lost him. Leia had him stop sending lest the signal be detected by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
